limitations.text: No imagery was available (imagery_window returned not_allowed for GSI and Sentinel-2; vision_subagent not configured), so NO candidate was visually verified and no claim has image evidence. Method: AEF 10 m embeddings pooled to 160 m cells (finest offered; Clay 1280 m too coarse), 3430 cells covering the full AOI (~88 km2). Linear probe trained on 16 PLATEAU training examples vs 200 random cells; threshold 0.8 gave 38 sites, 10 above the 75th-percentile score. Index is synthetic (fixture); 160 m cells cannot distinguish warehouses from factories, markets or hangars, and sites are cell centres, not building points (80 m tolerance may be missed). Estimated count: 10 (low) to 38 (high), best guess ~10-20; the top 10 sites are recorded as low-confidence (0.3) present. The other 28 are not claimed. Unreviewed: all cells below threshold (~3392 cells) and everything visually.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses/large logistics buildings (>=~1600 m2) in AOI near Nagoya port (136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N), 2024, as points with evidence, count range.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings can barely resolve buildings; warehouses vs factories ambiguous
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x8 km. Embedding retrieval to shortlist candidates, then verify with imagery windows (GSI aerial, Sentinel-2).
